pageProps.title: Manjaene Dongtan Branch
pageProps.review: A review of Manjaene Dongtan Branch, a Korean meat restaurant in Dongtan, Hwaseong-si, Gyeonggi-do. Check out this honest review and vivid photos of surprisingly excellent meat.
pageProps.content: ## Review I stumbled upon this place while looking for meat nearby. I didn't have high expectations, but the food was so good that I ended up eating a lot. I'd like to visit again if I get the chance. ## Pictures
